subject: [PATCH v3 4/7] sched/numa: separate VMA placement from scan continuation

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch separates the decision to place a VMA (Virtual Memory Area) for east-west sampling from the continuation of an ongoing scan across multiple scan windows. The helper function vma_is_accessed() is renamed to vma_needs_placement_scan() and its logic is split between determining placement eligibility and handling scan progress. This change allows PID-inactive VMAs to be scanned without mistakenly treating scan continuation as evidence of placement eligibility, which is a prerequisite for the next fix in this series.
